lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D array of high-luminance circular clusters, approximately 15-25 pixels in diameter, arranged in identifiable vertical columns and horizontal rows across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A visible horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank, demarcating a transition where spot density increases and individual spot diameter decreases toward the dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four Echeneidae (remora) specimens swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region, posterior to the pectoral fin.
